newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ governor to speak in parliament on Friday.
newsitem.headline: BOJ governor to speak in parliament on Friday.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita will attend a parliamentary committee meeting on Friday between 2.10 p.m. (0510 GMT) and 4.10 p.m. (0710 GMT) to answer questions from members of the Lower House, the BOJ said in a statement.
He will be answering questions on the reform of BOJ Law.
